name: Eden
self_text: Hi, I'm Eden! I'm a German woman in my late 20s. Outside of gaming, I love playing chess online. I mainly play Tidewatch on console and usually queue for casual matches. I'm typically free on Sunday afternoons or weekday evenings.

requests.request_text: I need you to be into casual matches. It would matter a lot if you are into Skyforge Arena or Tidewatch, though it's not a requirement. A big plus if you are available Sunday afternoon or weekday evenings, but I won't rule you out over it.
